judgements.justification: A's oT7u took the rebuttal answers as clarifications but said the changes 'require a major revision that is outside the scope of a conference cycle', and A's AC rejected on that ground; B treated the same fixes as camera-ready changes.
Neither AC cited an assessment outside the record; A's AC restated oT7u and B's AC followed the visible scores.
Both committees judged the paper as a method paper on the same terms; they differed on exposition and novelty, not on a standard tied to the contribution type.
A's low scores rest on central points (unclear Section 3.1, missing loss and proof, no grid-based baseline), not on a peripheral variant or presentation detail.
